summary.description: One or two sentences describing what the diff does and the overall security posture of the change.

findings.description: Security findings introduced or left exploitable by this diff. Empty array when the diff is clean.

confidence.description: How certain you are that this is a real, reachable vulnerability rather than a theoretical one.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file. Use 0 if not attributable to a single line.

evidence.description: The vulnerable code copied verbatim from the file at the cited line — one to five lines. No diff markers, no ellipses, no paraphrasing, no reconstruction from memory. This string is matched against the real file before the finding is accepted, and the finding is rejected if it is not found there.

description.description: What is wrong, referencing the specific added code.

exploit_scenario.description: Concrete attacker path: who sends what input, through which entry point, to what effect. Must be specific, not generic.

recommendation.description: The concrete fix, ideally with the corrected code shape.
